component.name: Sticky Notes
component.summary: Pixel-faithful Windows Sticky Notes app for Linux

description.p: An offline-first Sticky Notes app for Linux backed by a local SQLite database. Create colorful notes, pin them to your desktop, and search through all your notes from the Notes Manager.

ul.li: Sticky notes with multiple color themes
Rich text formatting (bold, italic, underline, strikethrough)
Offline-first with local SQLite database and Trash recovery

description.p: Migrates the rich text editor to Tiptap/ProseMirror, hardens Electron security (Fuses, main-process HTML sanitization, permission denials), adds persistent system tray lifecycle, soft-delete Trash recovery, export/backup, and full keyboard accessibility.
Improves note search and autosave, and creates a recovery copy before upgrading an existing notes database.
Security and performance improvements, plus support for checking or unchecking multiple selected checklist items at once.
